review.tagline: Python framework for temporal knowledge graphs that track how facts change
review.summary: Graphiti ingests text and JSON episodes into a knowledge graph of entities and facts, each with a validity window. Changed facts are invalidated rather than deleted, and every fact traces back to its source episode. Retrieval combines embeddings, BM25 and graph traversal. It runs on Neo4j, FalkorDB or Amazon Neptune, and ships an MCP server and a FastAPI service.
review.audience: Developers adding evolving, time-aware memory to agents with their own graph DB
strengths: Facts carry validity windows; old facts are invalidated, so past state stays queryable
Every derived fact traces to its source episode
Custom entity and edge types defined with Pydantic models
Includes an MCP server and a FastAPI REST service in the repo
weaknesses: Needs a separate graph database: Neo4j, FalkorDB or Neptune plus OpenSearch
Defaults to OpenAI; README warns other LLMs may break structured output
Kuzu driver is deprecated and will be removed
Users, threads and retrieval tuning are left to you; Zep covers them as a hosted product
